Fix Whitespace Error in GenForm Loss Annotation

fixNoLossSpace.Rd

This takes a filename with e.g. the output from annotateCleanMSMS and removes a space in the "no loss" annotation to allow for easier handling.

Usage

fixNoLossSpace(anno_MS_file, replace=TRUE)

Arguments

anno_MS_file

File name for annotated cleaned MSMS text file output from annotateCleanMSMS

replace

If TRUE, replace the input file. If FALSE, saved under the new name "*_ed.txt".

Value

File name of the "fixed" file.

See also

annotateCleanMSMS

Author

Emma Schymanski (emma.schymanski@uni.lu)
